prompt: A party room costs $\$40$ to rent plus $\$6$ per guest, and your whole budget is $\$100$. Solve $40 + 6g = 100$ to find how many guests $g$ you can invite. Give just the number.
hint: The room fee is one-time. Subtract $40$ from both sides first.

hints.text: The room fee is one-time. Subtract $40$ from both sides first.

alternativeExplanations.title: Budget leftovers
steps: Pay the room first: $\$100 - \$40$ leaves $\$60$ for guests.
Each guest costs $\$6$, so $60 \div 6 = 10$ guests fit the budget.
